name: Unown
dexEntry: This Pokémon is shaped like ancient writing. It is a mystery as to which came first, the ancient writings or the various Unown. Research into this topic is ongoing but nothing is known.

forms.name: Eerie
forms.dex: ''Another animation played for the Abra, where the Unown floated towards it and was pulled into its chest, causing it to disappear. The game then turned black again, except with the abra floating, holding the eye Unown above my fainted Pokémon. Their eyes were empty black pits, their colors greyed out and glitchy. The only color to be found was the small red crosses on my Pokémons' chests.''

forms.name: Mega
forms.dex: The power of Mega Evolution has awakened a hidden power within Unown. If an Unown comes to close to Mega Unown it is pulled in and absorbed into Mega Unown's body, never to be seen again. Some Researchers Believe this supports a new Theory that Unown is actually one Pokémon made of multiple bodies
